{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Evening Silk Slip Dress, bias cut, floor-length maxi, deep emerald green (#032B2B), silk crepe de chine
Cashmere Wrap Jacket, relaxed fit, hip-length, charcoal gray (#36454F), soft cashmere knit
Classic Leather Loafers, almond toe, block heel with 5cm height, polished black (#1C1C1C), smooth calfskin leather
Gold Vermeil Statement Necklace, wide band, oxidized gold finish, adjustable chain length
Pearl Drop Earrings, classic barrettes, freshwater cultured pearls, 8mm diameter, silver-plated post
Soft Tote Bag, structured shape, medium size, taupe (#4F5D5E), grained leather with gold hardware
Why this outfit works: This ensemble perfectly balances the smart dress code of an evening theatre outing with your specific wish for a long maxi skirt. The rich emerald silk slip provides an elegant silhouette that transitions seamlessly from day to night, while the charcoal cashmere jacket adds warmth and texture suitable for autumn evenings in the theater. Your chosen heels, ranging from 4 to 6 cm, offer the necessary height for sophistication without sacrificing comfort during a performance. Completing the look with gold jewelry ties together the earthy tones of the season while ensuring you feel polished and confident."}
